The company announced its rebrand on 24 September 2025 alongside an agentic platform designed to proactively detect, diagnose and resolve mobile-app quality and performance issues. Its software helps mobile teams manage feedback, crashes, performance and application quality throughout the app lifecycle. ## Luciq presentation [Watch on YouTube ↗](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=--mpJKuHJBU) ## Luciq funding6 rounds [All 6 rounds →](https://www.startuplist.africa/startups/luciq/fundings) Luciq has raised $53.1M across 6 rounds. The latest is a $46M Series B announced 17 May 2022.
